name: vibesdk-browser-capture-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda: headless-Chromium screenshot + console-log capture of a URL (a sandbox preview, typically), via real Playwright -- not an agentic computer-use loop, which is the wrong shape for a deterministic navigate-and-capture task. Replaces the CF BROWSER binding (@cloudflare/puppeteer) used by worker/agents/core/codingAgent.ts's captureScreenshot/captureBrowserConsoleLogs. Not part of the main vibesdk build.

scripts.package: npm run build && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/package.json && cd dist && zip -r ../browser-capture-lambda.zip handler.js package.json
